technical_and_design_decisions: U1: Namespace isolation for ZK metadata will be implemented via a configurable property (e.g., zk.namespace) in the application configuration, applied at ZK client creation.
U2: Interactive authentication will be added using Spring Security's authentication mechanism, with the shell prompting for credentials and sending them securely over HTTPS.
U3: A maintenance branch (e.g., 'maint/v1.0.x') will be created from the release tag; CI/CD pipelines will be configured to build and deploy from this branch for minor releases.
U4: Deprecated functions (e.g., module definition download) will be identified via @Deprecated annotations and usage search; removal will be done with accompanying test updates.

U5: After spike research, the chosen approach is to have xd-shell discover the admin server port via Zookeeper ephemeral nodes (direct ZK connection) for simplicity, with a fallback to a load balancer if needed.
U6: Kafka consumer will be upgraded to the 0.9+ consumer API (org.apache.kafka.clients.consumer.KafkaConsumer), requiring changes to consumer configuration and polling logic.
U7: Spike will focus on feasibility of Motion-JPEG streaming ingestion using JavaCV/FFmpeg; design specs will outline data format, pipeline stages, and integration points.

U8: Configuration parameter 'cluster.view.messageRates.enabled' will be added to servers.yml, bound to a Spring @ConfigurationProperties bean, and used to conditionally render message rates in the Admin UI cluster view.
